response.content: What function calculates the Black-Scholes-Merton European put option value from stock price, strike price, time to maturity, continuously compounded risk-free rate, and precomputed normal CDF values \(N(d1)\) and \(N(d2)\), using put-call parity or \(K e^{-rT}[1-N(d2)] - S[1-N(d1)]\), and returns the result to three decimal places?
